subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship an SSR changed-files summary/navigation card and hide interactive toolbar controls in static PNG/PDF exports?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded and plugin-local, but it intentionally changes user-visible viewer and exported artifact output on a protected maintainer-labeled feature request.

options.title: Accept Focused Diffs UX PR
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers approve the SSR summary/nav and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended Diffs UX.

options.title: Request Visual Export Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PR open until maintainers see real viewer plus PNG/PDF output proof for the new layout.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Keep only the multi-file summary/navigation or defer toolbar suppression if maintainers want separate product review.

recommendation.title: Accept Focused Diffs UX PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers approve the SSR summary/nav and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended Diffs UX.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the feature request and current file history points to him as the recent Diffs render/viewer contributor.
